test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A 200 m long train is running at a speed of 100 km/h. In how much time will it pass a man standing near the railway line?
solution:
Given:

Length of train = 200m

Speed of train = 100 km/h

Formula used:

Time = Distance/speed

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/sec

Calculations:

100 km/hr = 100 × 5/18

⇒ 250/9 m/sec

Time = 200/(250/9) 

⇒ TIme = 7.2 sec

∴ The required time is 7.2 sec.
